limitations_and_boundaries: All datasets are from cancer cell lines.
Did not attempt to improve original quality control (e.g., excluding perturbations that did not affect target gene expression).
CPA was not designed for unseen perturbation prediction; scFoundation could not be evaluated on single perturbation benchmarks due to gene matching requirements.
UCE may have had test data leakage due to overwriting perturbed genes with ground truth values.

research_questions.statement: Do deep-learning foundation models and other deep learning methods outperform simple linear baselines in predicting transcriptome changes after single or double genetic perturbations?

provenance.text_excerpt: All models had a prediction error substantially higher than the additive baseline (Fig. 1a,b).

claims.statement: All deep learning models had prediction error substantially higher than the additive baseline for double perturbation prediction.

provenance.text_excerpt: None of the models was better than the 'no change' baseline.

claims.statement: No deep learning model was better than the 'no change' baseline at predicting genetic interactions for double perturbations.

Repeated five times with different random splits.

methods.name: GEARS
methods.protocol_description: Deep learning model using Gene Ontology annotations to predict unseen perturbations.

methods.name: Geneformer*
methods.protocol_description: Fine-tuned on perturbation labels; in silico perturbation; linear decoder fitted via ridge regression.

methods.name: Linear model (LM)
methods.protocol_description: Represents each read-out gene with K-dimensional vector G and each perturbation with L-dimensional vector P. Finds W via ridge regression: argmin_W ||Y_train - (G W P^T + b)||_2^2 + ridge penalty. G and P derived from PCA of training data; K=10, λ=0.1.

methods.name: Linear model with pretrained embeddings
methods.protocol_description: Same as LM but using pretrained gene embedding G from scFoundation or scGPT, or perturbation embedding P from GEARS (spectral embedding of Gene Ontology matrix) or from Replogle data (10D PCA).

methods.name: Mean baseline
methods.protocol_description: Predicts the mean expression across all perturbations in the training set.

methods.name: scBERT*
methods.protocol_description: Fine-tuned on perturbation labels; perturbed embedding via overwriting; linear decoder fitted via ridge regression.

methods.name: UCE* (four-layer)
methods.protocol_description: Zero-shot; perturbed embedding via overwriting; linear decoder fitted via ridge regression.
